author: (Say, 1826)

note.en: A small nassa mud snail of sandy shallows across the western Atlantic. Here it is known from one old museum record (1929, listed as San Blas), so it is only a record.
note.es: Un caracol nassa pequeño de fondos arenosos someros del Atlántico occidental. Aquí solo se conoce por un registro antiguo de museo (1929, rotulado San Blas), así que es solo un registro.

evidence: GBIF: 1 museum record (1929) and 1 OBIS record in the region box

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: The one old museum record is listed as San Blas, outside Costa Rica.
